item.title: Lenovo ThinkPad E14 Gen 2
item.description:
Lenovo ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 Repair

The Lenovo ThinkPad E14 Gen 2 is a business-class device designed by Lenovo. It is part of the ThinkPad E Series and is known for its reliable performance, portability, and professional design.

Parts: Adhesives (1) Antennas (1) Batteries (1) Cables (8) Case Components (3) Display Components (1) Hinges and Hinge Pins (1) Keyboards (1) Motherboards (1) Power Adapters (2) RAM (4) Screens (1) Storage (2) Trackpads (1) Wireless Boards (1)
